languages.briefInfo: Free daily habit tracker with streaks. No account. No paywall. Ever.
languages.appDesc:
HabitCue tracks your daily habits and nothing more.

Add a habit, pick every day, specific weekdays, or a target number of times a week, and tap it done whenever you keep it. HabitCue keeps your current streak and your longest streak, and shows a simple monthly calendar so you can see the pattern at a glance.

Everything stays on your device. There is no account, no cloud, no coaching upsell and no trial that turns into a bill. Unlike most habit trackers, every feature here is free for every user: unlimited habits, every schedule type, full stats, from day one.

What you get:
• Unlimited habits with three schedule types: daily, specific weekdays, or N times a week
• Today view with everything due, one tap to mark done
• Current streak and longest streak per habit
• Monthly calendar and full completion history per habit
• One daily reminder at the hour you choose, only when something is still undone
• Overall stats: completion rate, best streak, completions this month
• Light, dark and system themes
• Interface in English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Italian, Turkish, Arabic and Chinese

HabitCue is free and supported by Huawei Petal Ads, shown only on the Habits and Stats screens — never on Today, never while you add or edit a habit.
languages.newFeatures: Initial release: unlimited habits, three schedule types, streaks, a monthly calendar and stats. Fully offline, no account, no paywall.
